podcast.title: High Investment and Producer (2010)
podcast.body: Liam Gallagher initiated the Bedi project by founding his own record label and spending a "fortune" to recruit Steve Lillywhite, one of the most important and expensive producers in the United Kingdom, known for his work with U2, to ensure a prominent return to the music scene. "liamgala guerr funda su propia discográfica para este nuevo proyecto y no solo eso sino que coge a Steve Lily Wipe que es uno de los productores más importantes y más caros del reino unido que ha trabajado con gente como youtube, en el que se gasta una auténtica millonada para hacer un poco una vuelta por todo lo alto."

podcast.title: Collaboration with Steve Lillywhite
podcast.body: BDI was among the many notable bands and artists with whom British producer Steve Lillywhite worked on albums. "Steve Lilley White, the British producer who worked on albums from You Too, The Psychedelic Furs, Peter Gabriel Simple Minds, Talking Heads, Morrissey, Rolling Stones, Dave Matthews, BDI, The Killer, Suzing the Banshees, and dozens more."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Stop Me If You've Heard This One Before

podcast.title: Formation Post-Oasis Split
podcast.body: After Oasis dissolved, Liam Gallagher formed Beady Eye, retaining the other former Oasis members Gem Archer, Andy Bell, and drummer Chris Sharrock. Beady Eye was the first of the Gallagher brothers' post-Oasis projects to release new music. "When Oasis broke up, it was Liam who retained custody of the rest of the band. The guitarist, Gammart, Jury Nandy Bell, along with drummer Chris Shorock stayed with him. He called the band BDI and they were the first out of the gate with new music."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Humiliating Concert Performance
podcast.body: A concert performance by Bedi was described as "one of the most humiliating concerts that we have had in modern music," indicating a significant disappointment in their live shows despite the high expectations. "fue uno de los conciertos yo creo que más humillantes que hemos tenido la música moderna."

podcast.title: One More Album Before Dissolution
podcast.body: Beady Eye released one additional album after "Different Gear Still Speeding" before Liam Gallagher decided to fold the band and launch a full-on solo career. "There was one more BDI album before Liam folded that tent with an idle launching of a full-on solo career."

podcast.title: Unfair Critical Reception
podcast.body: Some BDI material faced objective criticism, with their work being "crushed" by reviewers, despite possibly not being as bad as portrayed. This suggests a potential bias in the music press. "ya no se había pasado con algunos de los materiales de BDI que no pues posiblemente no habían sido todos los objetivos que devieran y un poco machacaban el trabajo cuando en el fondo pues posible no fuese tan malo."
